'''Izan Fernández Vieitez''' (born 3 October 2001) is an Andorran footballer who plays as a [[forward (association football)|forward]] for [[FC Rànger's]] and the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].

==Club career==
A youth product of [[FC Andorra]], he played three games for the club in the [[Primera Catalana]] and one in the Copa Catalunya. During the 2019–20 season he played for their subsidiary team which achieved promotion to [[Tercera Catalana]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.altaveu.com/actualitat/esport/fc-andorra-cedeix-izan-fernandez-mollerussa_23327_102.html|website=Altaveu.com|accessdate=5 June 2024|title= FC Andorra transfers Izan Fernández to Mollerussa|date=3 October 2020}}</ref> He joined Primera Catalans side [[CFJ Mollerussa]] in October 2020 when he was 19 years-old.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.andorradifusio.ad/esports/amp/izan-fernandez-jugara-cedit-mollerussa|website=Andorradifusio.ad|accessdate=5 June 2024|title= Izan Fernández will play on loan at Mollerussa|date=3 October 2020|first=Joan|last=Lopez}}</ref> He signed for [[UE Tàrrega]] in 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.novatarrega.cat/noticia/145910/la-ue-tarrega-es-reforca-amb-la-incorporacio-del-jove-davanter-izan#google_vignette|website=Novatarrega|date=24 November 2021|title= UE Tàrrega is strengthened with the addition of the young striker Izan |first=Francesc|last=Cairo|accessdate=5 June 2024}}</ref>

He joined Aragon based outfit [[Atlético Monzón]] in the summer of 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.diariandorra.ad/esports/230711/l-azuqueca-signa-izan-solana-alex-martinez_131570.html|website=Diarioandorra.ad|title= Azuqueca signs Izan and La Solana, Àlex Martínez|date=11 July 2022|accessdate=5 June 2024}}</ref> He scored his first goal for the club on 4 December 2022, in a 2–1 home league win against fellow Aragon side [[CD La Almunia]].<ref>{{cite web|website=Soccerway|title= ATLÉTICO MONZÓN VS. LA ALMUNIA 2 - 1|accessdate=1 April 2025|date=4 December 2022|url=https://uk.soccerway.com/matches/2022/12/04/spain/tercera-division/ca-monzon/cd-la-almunia/3913901/}}</ref> He left Atletico Monzon and signed for [[CD Azuqueca]], based in [[Azuqueca de Henares]], in July 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.andorraesportiu.com/linternacional-izan-fernandez-anunciat-com-a-nou-jugador-del-cd-azuqueca/?amp=1|website=Andorraesportiu.com|accessdate=5 June 2024|title= FUTBOLL'internacional Izan Fernández anunciat com a nou jugador del CD Azuqueca|first=Victor|last=Rodrigues|date=11 July 2023}}</ref> He scored his first goal for the club on 7 October 2023 against [[CF La Solana]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.latribunadeciudadreal.es/noticia/z754c5c06-0be8-594d-bb771d749e31b675/202310/la-solana-cosecha-su-primera-derrota|website=Latribunadeciudadreal|title= La Solana reaps its first defeat|date=October 7, 2023|accessdate=5 June 2024}}</ref>

He joined Spanish club [[CD Binéfar]] the [[Tercera Federación]] in the summer of 2024.<ref>{{cite web|language=Spanish|url= https://www.ondacerocinca.es/2024/12/03/izan-fernandez-somos-un-equipo-joven-con-mucha-ambicion/|website=Ondacerocina.es|accessdate=1 April 2025|title= Izan Fernández: "We're a young team with a lot of ambition."|date=3 December 2024}}</ref> He scored his first goal for the club in a 2–0 home league win against [[CD Fuentes]] on 26 October 2024.<ref>{{cite web|title=Binefar vs. Fuentes 2-0|date=26 October 2024|url=https://uk.soccerway.com/matches/2024/10/26/spain/tercera-division/club-deportivo-binefar/fuentes/4465587/|website=Soccerway}}</ref> His efforts for the club included scoring a goal in a 3–1 win against [[CD Cuarte]] in the league on 1 December 2024 to help move his club to the top of their division.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://uk.soccerway.com/players/izan-fernandez-vieitez/465837/|website=Soccerway|accessdate=1 April 2025|title= BINÉFAR VS. CUARTE 3 - 1|date=1 December 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.heraldo.es/noticias/deportes/aficion/2024/12/01/todas-cronicas-tercera-rfef-binefar-intratable-1782220.html|website=Heraldo.es|accessdate=1 April 2025|title= All the reports from the Third RFEF: Binéfar remains unstoppable|date=1 December 2024}}</ref>

==International career==
Fernández is a full international for the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.guadalajaradiario.es/deportes/58126-beltre-jugador-del-cd-azuqueca-internacional-por-la-republica-dominicana.html#google_vignette|website=Guadalarajaradiario|title= Beltre, CD Azuqueca player, international for the Dominican Republic|first=Stephen|last=Provencio|date=11 October 2023|accessdate=5 June 2024}}</ref> making his debut on 16 November 2022 against [[Austria national football team|Austria]].<ref>{{cite web |accessdate=5 June 2024 |date=16 November 2022 |title=Austria vs Andorra 1-0 |url=https://int.soccerway.com/matches/2022/11/16/world/friendlies/andorra/austria/3964944/ |website=Soccerway}}</ref> He was called-up again to the Andorra national team in November 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.eldiariodehuesca.com/deportes/cd-binefar-sigue-sin-encontrar-su-techo-suma-16-ultimos-18-puntos_26503_102_amp.html|website= eldiariodehuesca.com|accessdate=1 April 2025|title= CD Binéfar continues to struggle to find its ceiling: it has 16 of the last 18 points.|first=Adrian|last=Mora|language=Spanish|date=12 November 2024}}</ref>

==Style of play==
He is described as an attacking player, who is able to play wide on either wing, but also centrally as a striker.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.diariodelaltoaragon.es/noticias/deportes/2022/07/11/prosiguen-los-fichajes-a-menos-de-un-mes-de-arrancar-1587163-daa.html|website=Diariodeltoaragon|accessdate=5 June 2024|title= Signings continue less than a month after starting |date=11 July 2022}}</ref>
